privacy.title: Privacy and your data
privacy.note: Deleting removes your profile, addresses and saved payments. Order records we must keep for tax are kept without your name.

ride.title: Ride with BhojanGo
ride.lead: Deliver from local kitchens in your city, on your own hours, and see what a trip pays before you take it.

ride.apply_step2: Sign in with your phone number and add your vehicle and documents.
ride.apply_step3: We check them and switch you on. Then go online whenever you like.
ride.apply_note: Riders apply in the app only; we never ask for a fee to join.
